title: Canonical intent and entity output
description: Model-independent contract for one annotated user turn: exactly one primary intent plus normalized entities. Used for both ground truth and normalized model predictions. Model- or provider-specific data (probabilities, scores, reasoning, token usage, latency, raw responses) is out of scope and belongs in a separate execution-result schema. Vocabularies and patterns mirror test_data/taxonomy/entities.yaml and intents.yaml (spec_version 0.1.0).

test_case_id.description: Stable identifier of the test case (for example CPG-001). Multi-turn cases share one test_case_id and are distinguished by turn_index.

turn_index.description: 1-based index of the user turn being annotated within a multi-turn conversation. Counts user turns only. Omit for single-turn cases.

intent.description: Exactly one primary intent from test_data/taxonomy/intents.yaml.

allOf.$comment: Unsupported turns carry no entities (entities.yaml global_rules.grounding).

text_value.description: Open-class canonical name: non-empty, no leading, trailing or repeated whitespace.

entities.description: All entity keys are always present. A not-stated entity is the empty array []; null and empty strings are invalid. Values are canonical, unique and in order of first mention.

manufacturer.description: Company that makes or owns the brand (supplier or manufacturer). Normalization: preserve.

product.description: A specific product or product line below brand level (brand plus variant, flavour or formulation), excluding pack size and pack type. Normalization: preserve.

sub_category.description: Segment within a category. Each value has exactly one parent category (documentation only). Normalization: controlled_vocabulary.

pack_size.description: Size of the sellable unit or multipack as stated (volume or weight, count x size, or pack count). Normalization: pack_size_format.

pack_type.description: Physical container or packaging format. Normalization: controlled_vocabulary.

channel.description: Retail or trade channel. Normalization: controlled_vocabulary.

retailer.description: Named retail customer or banner. Normalization: preserve.

geography.description: Country, region, city or other named market area. Normalization: preserve.

promotion_type.description: Promotion mechanic or tactic. Normalization: controlled_vocabulary.

discount.description: Stated depth of a promotional price reduction, as a percentage or an absolute amount off. Normalization: discount_format.

date_range.description: Time period requested, as stated (absolute or relative). Normalization: date_expression.

items.pattern: ^(?:(?:FY)?[0-9]{4}(?:-(?:Q[1-4]|H[12]|W(?:0[1-9]|[1-4][0-9]|5[0-3])|(?:0[1-9]|1[0-2])(?:-(?:0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01]))?))?(?:/(?:FY)?[0-9]{4}(?:-(?:Q[1-4]|H[12]|W(?:0[1-9]|[1-4][0-9]|5[0-3])|(?:0[1-9]|1[0-2])(?:-(?:0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01]))?))?)?|(?:Q[1-4]|H[12])|(?:last|this|next) (?:week|month|quarter|half|year)|(?:last|next) (?:[2-9]|[1-9][0-9]+) (?:days|weeks|months|quarters|years)|(?:year|quarter|month|week) to date|same period last year|(?:(?:last|this|next) )?(?:spring|summer|autumn|winter|holiday season|back to school)|(?:spring|summer|autumn|winter|holiday season|back to school) [0-9]{4}|(?:january|february|march|april|may|june|july|august|september|october|november|december)|since (?:(?:FY)?[0-9]{4}(?:-(?:Q[1-4]|H[12]|W(?:0[1-9]|[1-4][0-9]|5[0-3])|(?:0[1-9]|1[0-2])(?:-(?:0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01]))?))?|(?:january|february|march|april|may|june|july|august|september|october|november|december)))$

metric.description: Business measure requested. Generic values (sales, market_share, price, distribution, incremental_sales) are used when the user does not state a more specific basis; never resolve them to a more specific metric. Normalization: controlled_vocabulary.
